criterion.primary: Browser monotonic file-input change to visible import completion
criterion.target: At least 5% median paired reduction against both A and identical C on each independent host, and at least five of six faster pairs against each control on each host
criterion.nonTarget: No more than 3% median paired regression against either control on either independent host; report every result even if this screen fails
criterion.correctness: Every import passes original production-default validation; all 72 public lookup hashes match across arms, passes and restart; full media payload verification in A/B after timed observations on replica 0
criterion.observations: All scheduled observations retained; no exclusions, replacements or outcome-dependent reruns; warmups and validation observations excluded from timing by schedule
criterion.memory: Timing observations have process sampling disabled. Changes affecting retained buffers require a separate prospectively specified process-tree memory qualification
